inputs.text: They’re presenting the measures as routine border policy, but the timing points to a coordinated tightening after Bill C-12 received royal assent on March 26, 2026. The headline says Nigerians and others are in the crosshairs; the reassuring language around “strengthening” the system looks like a way to sell a broader clampdown while obscuring who benefits from it.
